entities.name: Susuki Village
entities.description: A kitsune village on the edge of the Towabara Plains bordering the Jukai forest, sheltered from the Kami War.

entities.name: Eight-and-a-Half-Tails
entities.description: Renowned kitsune elder who called Susuki Village home.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: Distant location whose distance sheltered the village.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War whose effects barely reached the village.

relations.quote: The village was the home of the renowned elder Eight-and-a-Half-Tails

relations.note: It lay on the plains' far edge.
relations.quote: Susuki Village lay on the far edge of Towabara Plains
